short: Artifact-remix augmentation repeats 2024 reference-signal mixing, gains 3.3 points (not 4.7) only with 10-trial averaging, barely beats white noise, and does not directly test the claimed invariance.
position: The paper changes training-set augmentation (M03), standard against the field: re-injecting recorded artifact signals from other trials was done for EEG speech decoding in 2024 and is not cited; ICA-based projection is the refinement. Its gain needs ten averaged imaginings per decision (M04), behind single-trial practice; at single trial neither model gains beyond seed error, as the authors concede. At 10 trials EEGNet rises from 73.0% to 76.3%, not the stated 4.7 points and 77.6%, generic white noise reaches 0.747 against 0.763, and baselines are tuned and placed differently. The claimed invariance to tracked artifacts is not directly tested.
